story: Stage 4 of the Vuelta featured an early breakaway of five riders, but Lidl-Trek kept the gap under control and the peloton caught the escapees early. A few late attacks followed, though none proved dangerous. The stage was set for a bunch sprint, Jasper Philipsen got boxed in by his own teammate. Ben Turner powered through to take his first Grand Tour stage win.
